messages:
priya: quick ping — I opened a small telemetry PR touching console dashboards + trace hook tagging. can someone take a look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1692

priya: main changes: rename metric `console_latency_ms` -> `console_response_ms` and add `route` label to trace hook. tests updated. diff snippet below:
```diff
- gauge("console_latency_ms", ...)
+ gauge("console_response_ms", labels={"route": route})
```

liam: :eyes: will skim in ~30m. any perf/regression risk here?

ana_typo_fix: oops ignore (accidental message)

liam: looks straightforward from code. my main ask is a quick smoke run on staging to ensure no tag explosion from `route`. non-blocking.

ana_typo_fix: sorry, stray post — ignore me

ana: @priya can we gate merge until after the 3:30pm PT canary? if it's just a rename + label i think it's fine to land after canary.

priya: yup happy to wait. smoke passed locally and unit/integration updated. the route label is low-cardinality for our dashboards.

sam: I can give final approval once CI finishes. note: alerting rules reference `console_latency_ms` — I'll update those in infra after merge. filing infra follow-up (#456).

tia: small request — please add a 1-line changelog in the PR description about the metric rename so infra+oncall can spot it. otherwise :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI status — all checks passed (unit, lint, integration) at 1863456900 :white_check_mark:

liam: left one tiny nit about label ordering in the hook (non-blocking). approving now. :+1:

priya: thanks everyone — merging in ~5m if no objections. I'll monitor dashboards and can roll back if anything weird shows up.

sam: thanks — I'll update alert rules post-merge. :rocket:

tia: thanks! :eyes:

priya: merged and pushed. will follow up in #incidents if any anomalies.
